reader_summary.overview: Jon Wertheim is a sports journalist and author who has a passion for psychology and economics. He is the Executive Editor at Sports Illustrated, where he has been a full-time staff member since 1996. Jon also is a contributing correspondent on 60 Minutes and an analyst for the Tennis Channel at the four Majors.

key_points.text: He is the author of ten books including Stokes of Genius about the Federer-Nadal rivalry, the New York Times bestseller Scorecasting , and more recently.
Our conversation spans across sports, behavior and decision making, discussing Jon's path to a career in sports journalism, insider perspective on tennis.
Jon moves with ease across sports, investing and psychology.
